issues.title: bug(markdown-syntax-identity): resolve opaque document IDs containing separators
issues.body:
Parent capability request: Blog #1805 / UI #829; canonical identity boundary #322 / #286. New defect, no implementation owner claimed.

Observed through the real existing Blog local alias and public adapter at UI `06abdea678a8cb74682b83cc93e1ff31d3b271da` + Blog `b15a01d6bb1a8714adfb66fb3d635b4e69d36c32`:

```ts
const identity = { id: 'article-a:tab', epoch: 1 }
const model = createMarkdownOutlineModel('#\n\n#  \n', identity)
model.items.map(item => model.projection.resolve(item.nodeId).status)
// ['invalid', 'invalid']; ordinary id 'doc-a' returns ['current', 'current']
```

Both canonical empty headings, their `empty-heading` diagnostics, raw/content ranges and stable IDs are retained. After prefix edits the IDs remain stable, but resolution still returns invalid. The public `MarkdownDocumentIdentity.id` is an opaque string; the resolver compares `id.split(':')[1]` to the entire document ID. This affects non-empty nodes too and must be repaired in the canonical identity authority, not by a consumer parser or lookup kernel.

Acceptance for the assigned canonical owner:
- Preserve existing node-ID encoding and canonical projection authority.
- Resolve current nodes for opaque IDs containing separators; distinguish another document, stale epoch and deleted nodes using the existing statuses.
- Cover same-source different-documents, prefix edits and stale epochs with genuine negative controls.
- Reverify public local-alias consumer behavior on an exact candidate; local evidence must not be described as published-package parity.

Original #829/#842 ownership is retained; parent should assign the canonical resolver owner before source changes. No package publishing, consumer regex/private selector workaround, security-gate change, merge or fabricated browser evidence.

issues.title: fix(markdown-renderer): preserve theme invalidation during pending activation
issues.body:
PR #840 exposes two independently reproducible defects already present on its base: the committed icon registry is missing five exports in its generated index, so the canonical visual producer invalidates its own source fingerprint; MarkdownRenderer installs the shared theme listener only after asynchronous heavy-feature activation settles, so a theme event during pending activation is lost.

Bounded follow-up for FsusBlog #1805 / FsusUI #829. Keep their acceptance requirements unchanged. PR #840 head `8ce8d0027590a96c6aed5250a14219b71b0eb624` stays frozen for separate review.

Acceptance:
- Commit only owning icon-generator output and prove repeat preparation stays fresh without weakening fingerprint checks.
- Fix pending activation theme invalidation inside MarkdownRenderer; preserve stale-result abort, unmount cleanup and the existing shared-theme assertion. Add a regression that proves the race before repair.
- Bind focused unit, locked-dependency type checks and applicable browser results to exact commits. Record genuine remaining failures separately; no fabricated receipts, baseline updates, package publication or merge.

The original 18 remote failures also include Avalonia contract assertions, native fixture paths/shortcuts/PDF tools, real-render performance and downstream aggregate failures. These remain separately attributable; this issue does not claim their qualification or take over another owner.

issues.title: feat(image-viewer): provide an SSR-safe public teleport contract
issues.body:
## Problem

The public ElImageViewer teleported=true mode always targets body. Rendering the initially open viewer with Vue SSR and then hydrating a normal consumer document produces a hydration node mismatch. The public API provides no SSR-safe target selection or documented lifecycle equivalent.

## Executed evidence

The linked consumer fixture uses createSSRApp on server and browser, identical visible/list/index inputs, renderToString's real context.teleports output, and the existing FsusBlog Vite configuration/public aliases and CSP. No old dialog or client fallback is present.

- Initially closed SSR followed by opening: passes.
- Initially open ElImageViewer with teleported=true: two image elements after hydration, but Vue warns Hydration node mismatch at BaseTransition/Transition/ElImageViewer and Hydration completed but contains mismatches.
- The same SSR harness with a plain Vue Teleport into a dedicated #probe-teleports host: exactly one control and no hydration mismatch. This control verifies server teleport injection and client hydration rather than treating any SSR warning as a library result.
- The initially open library markup also emits inline-style CSP violations under the unchanged consumer style-src-attr 'none' policy. No policy was weakened. A 502 CSP-report response is an unavailable backend reporting endpoint, not a hydration success.

## Required public contract and tests

- [ ] Provide a documented SSR-safe ImageViewer teleport target/lifecycle that works within a consumer document containing background content.
- [ ] Initially open and initially closed SSR/client inputs hydrate with one viewer and zero hydration mismatch, including repeated open/close and route unmount.
- [ ] Preserve focus/trap/return, scroll/inert cleanup, safe-area and close/navigation behavior; no hidden fallback dialog or duplicated overlay.
- [ ] Component-level SSR test plus a browser consumer fixture must inject actual server teleport output and retain the dedicated-host positive control.
- [ ] Exercise the consumer's actual CSP. Resolve the public composition/SSR-style contract without weakening it or requiring consumer private DOM repair; document any separately owned limitation precisely.
- [ ] Run the same consumer fixture with local source and the real published artifact. Screenshot evidence alone cannot establish hydration or cleanup.

## Baseline and reproduction

Baseline: FsusUI/main@f2b3bb89ffe5f749da26c388f058efdbb6aee864 (clean checkout, remote verified 2026-10-08). FsusBlog consumer candidate: 27d850003621c768a0c7b0a7ac0b48a1f79334cd, branch chain/1892-imageviewer-probe. Chromium 151.0.7922.173, Node v24.19.0. Real consumer probe run: 2026-10-08T02:50:53.882Z-15661.

Consumer fixture: https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusBlog/blob/27d850003621c768a0c7b0a7ac0b48a1f79334cd/tests/frontend/fixtures/imageViewerConsumerProbe.ts
Probe: https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusBlog/blob/27d850003621c768a0c7b0a7ac0b48a1f79334cd/tests/frontend/checks/runtime/probe-image-viewer-consumer.mjs
Reproduce from FsusBlog with the documented local FsusUI alias: `NODE_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE=1 node tests/frontend/checks/runtime/probe-image-viewer-consumer.mjs local .tmp/image-viewer-probe/local`. Exit 1 preserves failed checks; exit 2 means unavailable capability. The same fixture also supports published mode; exact locked @ozwasyd/element-plus@1.5.1 was unavailable in this environment (download HTTP 401), so there is no published runtime claim.

This is an upstream capability request needed by https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusBlog/issues/1892. No consumer workaround, private selector, duplicated modal owner, or upstream source edit was made. This issue does not authorize product acceptance or deployment.

issues.title: feat(image-viewer): expose accessible content and navigation composition
issues.body:
## Problem

ElImageViewer's public URL-only API cannot retain per-image alternative text and consumer-localized control names while the consumer removes its own viewer controls.

## Executed evidence

- Successful image DOM has no alt attribute. Only load failure sets a generic localized error alt.
- The default slot renders the consumer caption text, but it does not associate that text with the displayed image. Do not remove the working slot.
- There are no public image-alt or close/previous/next naming props; root aria-label does not fall through the Teleport root. Accessible lookups for 关闭大图/上一张/下一张 return 0 controls.
- Public emits are close/switch/rotate only. Keyboard and touch navigation emit switch and work at non-infinite first/last boundaries, but direction-specific previous/next intent is absent. A two-image circular product cannot distinguish direction from the resulting index alone.
- initialIndex updates do not change the active image. The existing public setActiveItem method does work; document this synchronization path or provide a controlled index API rather than forcing consumer remounts.
- The public component always adds zoom/mode/rotate tools. FsusBlog's existing product only adopts close and previous/next; there is no documented navigation-only control configuration.

## Required public contract

Expose generic per-image alt/caption composition, localized accessible names for the dialog and all enabled controls, navigation intent sufficient to adapt previous/next product events (including a two-image circular list), and a documented controlled index/list path. Provide a documented way to select only the controls the product adopts. Keep all content, locale strings and business collections in the consumer.

## Component tests and consumer acceptance

- [ ] Distinct alt and caption for each active image, including empty and long text; retain the working caption slot and accessible description association.
- [ ] Consumer-provided accessible dialog, close, previous/next and enabled-tool names in multiple locales without DOM patching.
- [ ] External index/list changes use the documented public API, preserve focus and do not create duplicate overlays.
- [ ] Single image, finite boundaries and circular two-image navigation retain precise intent events for keyboard, touch and pointer inputs.
- [ ] Navigation-only configuration adds no unadopted zoom/rotation/download features; enabled tools stay named and usable.
- [ ] Load failure is nonblank, accessible and closable.
- [ ] Run the linked consumer contract against local source and the actual published artifact; no private imports/selectors or local compatibility fork.

issues.title: feat(image-viewer): provide a complete public modal lifecycle
issues.body:
## Problem

ElImageViewer does not currently provide the reusable modal lifecycle required by a consumer to remove its hand-owned dialog, focus and scroll-lock code.

## Executed evidence

- Opening focuses the wrapper, but Shift+Tab escapes to the background action.
- Background programmatic focus succeeds; no inert boundary is enforced.
- Body/html overflow remains visible. PageDown changes background scrollY from 100 to 838 while open.
- Escape emits close and removes the viewer, but focus returns to BODY rather than the original trigger.
- There is no role=dialog/aria-modal surface; consumer aria-label fallthrough is rejected at the Teleport root.
- Normal close and interrupted unmount remove the images and listener cleanup passes. Preserve these positive controls.

## Required owning change

Provide one public ImageViewer modal lifecycle (or documented public viewer primitives) owning dialog semantics, initial focus, Tab/Shift+Tab containment, background inert state, body scroll lock and focus/scroll restoration. Keep business images, copy, captions and routes in the consumer. Do not add an article-specific concept.

## Component tests and consumer acceptance

- [ ] Named modal dialog, keyboard focus entry and trap in both directions.
- [ ] Background pointer/keyboard/programmatic focus exclusion and wheel/touch/PageDown scroll exclusion.
- [ ] Close control, Escape, mask dismissal, external close and unmount restore focus and prior scroll/overflow/inert state exactly.
- [ ] Repeated opens/closes, interrupted unmount, initially closed SSR and nested existing modal ownership have no residue or competing owner.
- [ ] Preserve close/switch events, single/multiple image behavior and listener cleanup.
- [ ] Run the linked real consumer fixture on local source and the actual published artifact; retain failed negative controls and bind the exact commits/runs.

issues.title: feat(collection): expose accessible disabled single-selection DataList rows
issues.body:
Related to https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusBlog/issues/1894 and https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusBlog/issues/1895.

## Bounded public capability request

Provide a generic, accessible, controlled single-selection collection row contract through the existing public DataList/FsusDataList surface. FsusBlog keeps plugin IDs, metadata, health copy, selected identity, API calls and detail workflows. This issue does not move plugin models or page composition into FsusUI.

## Current executable evidence

- FsusBlog baseline: `3bc9bacd55b4453ed0abd48632c6a1bb3f7944f8`.
- Consumer probe commit: [76336e2594cb532a1b40e372395ea0b662835f37](https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusBlog/commit/76336e2594cb532a1b40e372395ea0b662835f37).
- Real local FsusUI: [f2b3bb89ffe5f749da26c388f058efdbb6aee864](https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusUI/commit/f2b3bb89ffe5f749da26c388f058efdbb6aee864), fetched and clean. The relevant DataList/ResponsiveCollection/Menu source units are unchanged relative to Blog's configured pin `6c836baff8bc1879b487bf019359fd5e433f58ea`; source equality is not pinned runtime qualification.
- Chromium 147.0.7727.15 / Playwright chromium revision 1217.
- Command: `node tests/frontend/checks/runtime/check-plugin-collection-probe.mjs both`.
- Probe exit code: 1. Both Git source identities remained unchanged.
- Fixture imports only documented public APIs, using Blog's existing DataList adapter and local-alias resolver. It does not patch private selectors, add native row buttons or supply a consumer keyboard owner.

Observed DataList failures:
1. Interactive native button rows expose `role=listitem` in the real Chromium accessibility tree. Current identity is present as `aria-current`, but the actionable button role is lost.
2. With the selected row's public `loadingKey` set, Enter and Space still emit two row activations. Loading has no accessible disabled state. A public disabled/loading activation contract is required; CSS pointer suppression is insufficient.
3. In forced-colors, a focused navigation row has `focus-visible=true`, `outline-style=none`; box-shadow focus feedback is removed by forced colors. A visible system-color focus outline is required.

DataList passes stable plugin ID selection, duplicate-name selection, controlled current identity, ordinary Tab/Enter/Space, ready touch activation, empty/loading/error public feedback composition, 0/1/1000 row counts and three repeated 1000-row mount/unmount global-listener checks. Each candidate ran 18 width/theme/count cells (375/768/1440 × light/dark × 0/1/1000) with no page errors. Width/field-presence checks do not establish long-content readability or full visual acceptance.

Alternative probes:
- ResponsiveCollection provides layout slots but no selection/activation/focus kernel; using it alone would leave a Blog-owned generic kernel.
- Vertical Menu has pointer/touch activation, but rows are not Tab-reachable, current/selected and disabled state are not accessible, and forced-colors focus is missing. It is not the chosen master-list owner.

Published `@ozwasyd/element-plus@1.5.1` was not installed; configured registry read returned 401 with no package credential. Published probing is explicitly blocked, not inferred from local source or a locally built tarball.

Raw reports, accessibility trees and hashed screenshots are retained privately with the task evidence. These are component capability diagnostics, not authenticated PluginAdmin or independent UX acceptance.

## Required public contract and tests

- Preserve stable row keys and controlled single selection, with no internal selection divergence when a consumer declines an activation.
- Expose a valid interactive row role and accessible current/selected state; keep metadata cell slots and existing navigation behavior.
- Define public row/collection disabled and loading behavior. Pointer, keyboard and touch must reject activation consistently while disabled/busy; announce that state.
- Provide keyboard traversal/activation and visible focus in light/dark and forced-colors, without consumer DOM/ref queries or CSS repairs.
- Keep responsive geometry and public empty/loading/error composition; retain all name/ID/version/status/runtime content in the consumer fixture.
- Cover 0/1/1000 rows, duplicate labels, long IDs, reorder, repeated mount/unmount and listener cleanup in component tests.
- Run the same real PluginAdmin consumer contract through public local aliases and the actual published package. Require 375/768/1440, zoom, keyboard, touch, accessibility-tree assertions and inspected screenshots; record human screen-reader and independent acceptance limits honestly.
- Add focused negative controls for loading keyboard activation, invalid interactive role, loss of controlled identity and missing forced-colors focus.
- Update the nearest public component documentation and appropriate changeset.

## Cutover condition

FsusBlog #1894 waits until an exact upstream prerequisite commit and passing component/consumer evidence are supplied by the coordinator, including genuine published/local parity. Then migrate its master list once and delete the native row list and generic row CSS. No Blog-local selectable-list wrapper, private selector repair, fallback or parallel selection store is acceptable.

issues.title: feat(dropdown): expose public single-selection menu item semantics
issues.body:
Related to [FsusBlog #1891](https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusBlog/issues/1891). That assigned issue explicitly requires an atomic FsusUI issue when its mandatory public menu probe reveals an upstream capability gap.

## Public contract gap

Expose documented single-selection menu item semantics through Dropdown or a documented equivalent public primitive composition. Keep selection value, async resource/preference transactions, locale content, URLs and retry copy in the consumer.

In [dropdown-item-impl.vue at main@f2b3bb89ffe5f749da26c388f058efdbb6aee864](https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusUI/blob/f2b3bb89ffe5f749da26c388f058efdbb6aee864/vue/packages/components/dropdown/src/dropdown-item-impl.vue), the explicit item role is computed as menuitem for a menu parent and applied after the attrs spread. Passing role=menuitemradio and aria-checked does not produce a valid radio item. The [public Dropdown API](https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusUI/blob/f2b3bb89ffe5f749da26c388f058efdbb6aee864/docs/components/dropdown.md) does not document an item checked/selection contract.

The public consumer probe is [FsusBlog commit 646d8c1a2293fa0b35eb76f8343b7f2711bbf97d](https://github.com/Ozwasyd/FsusBlog/commit/646d8c1a2293fa0b35eb76f8343b7f2711bbf97d), under tests/frontend/probes/locale-menu. It mounts the public root exports and exercises Dropdown, Dropdown + Menu, and Select. Its runner accepts local or published mode, a dependency root, and a disposable evidence directory; exit 2 identifies capability gaps and exit 3 identifies an unavailable probe. It records current DOM observations and exact source identities. This is a prerequisite probe, not product acceptance.

## Atomic acceptance

- [ ] Document and expose menu/menuitemradio + aria-checked, or one coherent equivalent single-selection public contract.
- [ ] Preserve consumer-owned committed selection while async activation is unresolved or fails; hide-on-click=false keeps pending/error/retry reachable.
- [ ] Keep public visibility control/events, custom compact trigger slots, popup geometry/surface, disabled behavior and keyboard focus under the library owner.
- [ ] Run current browser tests for exactly one checked item, state changes, ArrowUp/Down/Home/End/Enter/Space, Escape focus return, outside dismissal, repeated open/close, disabled activation, async pending/failure/retry and cleanup.
- [ ] Support URL and command items through documented composition or an explicit public activation adapter; do not require private DOM or a second keyboard owner.
- [ ] Negative controls reject menuitem with aria-checked, half-committed selection, immediate pending close, broken Escape focus return and a private-selector workaround.
- [ ] Supply the exact upstream source commit and an accessible published package identity; the consumer probe must run against both, with no fallback.
- [ ] Cover RTL, light/dark, forced-colors, reduced-motion and narrow/wide states; update the nearest API docs and required changeset.

No locale-specific high-level component or consumer transaction belongs in FsusUI. Do not add a Blog-local generic menu, private ref/deep import repair, compatibility fallback, or dual owner. This issue requests a prerequisite capability; no merge, deployment, or issue closure is requested.

issues.title: bug(markdown-outline): preserve empty ATX headings and canonical diagnostic
issues.body:
Downstream: Ozwasyd/FsusBlog#1805
Regression of the closed acceptance boundary in #436.

## Current evidence

Verified against current `main@f2b3bb89ffe5f749da26c388f058efdbb6aee864`:

```bash
./node_modules/.bin/tsx -e "import { createMarkdownOutlineModel } from './vue/packages/components/markdown-editor/src/markdown-editor-outline.ts'; const m=createMarkdownOutlineModel('#\n\n#  \n',{id:'doc',epoch:1}); console.log(JSON.stringify({count:m.items.length,items:m.items}));"
```

Observed:

- the valid empty ATX heading `#` is absent;
- `#  ` is retained as an empty heading;
- the retained item has `diagnostics: []`;
- the existing test `empty.items.every((item) => item.text === '')` passes vacuously if no empty items are projected, so it does not bind count or diagnostics.

The observed result has one item, not two:

```json
{"count":1,"items":[{"depth":1,"text":"","diagnostics":[]}]}
```

## Required correction

- Keep every parser-recognized empty ATX heading in the canonical projection/outline, including the end-of-line form `#`.
- Preserve stable node identity and raw/content ranges exactly as for non-empty headings.
- Emit a canonical `empty-heading` structural diagnostic from FsusUI so consumers do not derive it from text or reparse Markdown.
- Add non-vacuous tests that assert exact item count, source ranges, diagnostics, and stable identity across edits for both `#` and `#  `.
- Keep the existing parser/projection authority; do not add a consumer regex or DOM path.

FsusBlog #1805 cannot satisfy its mandatory empty-heading and canonical-diagnostic acceptance without this upstream contract.

issues.title: fix(vue/public-shell): el-public-shell 头部在短横屏下堆叠至 ~94px 逻辑高度，超过可用 chrome 高度预算
issues.body:
## 缺陷

`el-public-shell` / `el-site-header` 公共头部在短横屏（如 mobile-landscape 844×390）下 inner 高度约 94px 逻辑像素（CSS zoom 1.5 时量测 142px），占视口高度 ~37%，超过「landscape chrome ≤34%」的可用高度预算。双主题、全公共路由复现。

## 复现证据（消费者 FsusBlog 真实渲染验收）

- 环境：FsusBlog UX viewport 验收（Chromium，真实后端 + 生产构建）
- 用例：全公共路由 `mobile-landscape` + `zoom-150`（boundaries 矩阵）
- 断言输出：`landscape chrome consumes too much height (144px of 390px)`——消费者侧把 6rem min-height 预留降至 3.25rem 后为 142px，剩余高度全部来自 `el-public-shell__inner` 自身几何
- 现场量测：`header.el-public-shell__header` 142px rendered；`__inner` 141px；`__primary-row` 69px（≈46px 逻辑）；brand/nav/action 行各 ~40px 逻辑——inner 内存在第二行或大 padding 使总高达 ~94px 逻辑

## 期望

短横屏（height≤520px 且 width>height）下公共 shell 头部折叠为单行紧凑形态（参考组件既有 compact/mobile 表达），chrome 总高 ≤34% 视口；zoom-200 下亦成立（逻辑 ≤66px）。

## 范围边界

- FsusUI 公共 shell 组件的响应式几何缺陷；消费者不做私有选择器覆盖
- 消费者侧已同步把 Blog 侧 6rem 首屏预留在短横屏降为 3.25rem（必要条件，非充分条件）
- 消费者侧 issue：Ozwasyd/FsusBlog#3475
- FsusUI 基线：`f2b3bb89ffe5f749da26c388f058efdbb6aee864`

issues.title: fix(vue/drawer): ElDrawer 面板/交互子元素在 landscape-notch 下量测到视口左缘之外
issues.body:
## 缺陷

`ElDrawer`（`direction="ltr"`）在 landscape-notch safe-area profile 下，其交互子元素（含内部 `el-drawer__close-btn` 与消费者内容链接）被量测到负 left 坐标——位于 safe rect 左缘（inset 59px）之外，甚至整个视口左缘之外。Chromium 与 WebKit 均复现，偏移量不同，疑似隐藏态 transform 驻留或 safe-area inset 未参与面板几何。

## 复现证据（消费者 FsusBlog 真实渲染验收）

- 环境：FsusBlog UX viewport 验收 safe-area 矩阵（真实后端 + 生产构建）
- 用例：`user-profile` → `account-drawer` → `landscape-notch`（844×390，insets left 59 / right 59 / bottom 21）→ `light`
- safe rect：`{"left":59,"top":0,"right":785,"bottom":369}`
- Chromium 违规示例：`el-drawer__close-btn` `left=-71.46 right=-17.46`；`account-module-link` `left=-288.46 right=-17.46`
- WebKit 违规示例：`account-module-link` `left=-84.31 right=186.69`
- 消费者 drawer 用法：`direction="ltr"`、`size="min(86vw, 22rem)"`、自定义 header slot——均为公开 props，无内部选择器覆盖

## 期望

drawer 面板及其交互内容在 landscape-notch 下完整落在 safe rect 内；关闭/隐藏态不应对验收暴露可交互、可量测的越界几何（如需要 `visibility`/`inert` 语义请按组件契约处理）。

## 范围边界

- FsusUI 面板几何/safe-area 处理缺陷；若裁定消费者 `size` 需收缩也请在 FsusUI 契约层面说明（公开 prop 语义）
- 消费者侧 issue：Ozwasyd/FsusBlog#3475
- FsusUI 基线：`f2b3bb89ffe5f749da26c388f058efdbb6aee864`

issues.title: fix(vue/dialog): ElDialog 关闭后 focus restore 在 WebKit portrait-notch 下超时未回到触发元素
issues.body:
## 缺陷

`ElDialog` 关闭后焦点恢复（focus restore 至触发按钮）在 WebKit + portrait-notch profile 下 3000ms 内未成立；同一 profile 的 Chromium 通过。focus return 是共享 overlay 交互语义，属 FsusUI 组件层。

## 复现证据（消费者 FsusBlog 真实渲染验收）

- 环境：FsusBlog UX viewport 验收 safe-area 矩阵（真实后端 + 生产构建）
- 用例：`public-register` → `fsus-dialog` → `portrait-notch`（390×844，insets top 47 / bottom 34）→ `light` → **webkit**
- 断言输出：`safe-area:fsus-dialog:portrait-notch:light:webkit focus restore` — `Expected: true, Received: false`，`Timeout 3000ms exceeded while waiting on the predicate`
- 对照：同 surface 同 profile 的 **chromium 通过**；`short-visual` profile 的 scrollY 差异另案定性为测试基线时序问题，与本项无关

## 期望

WebKit 下 ElDialog 关闭后焦点确定性回到打开它的触发元素，与 Chromium 行为一致。

## 范围边界

- FsusUI 共享 overlay/focus-trap 语义缺陷，消费者不做私有覆盖
- 消费者侧 issue：Ozwasyd/FsusBlog#3475
- FsusUI 基线：`f2b3bb89ffe5f749da26c388f058efdbb6aee864`

issues.title: fix(vue/markdown-editor): command-more 溢出按钮以 sticky 定位随工具栏纵向滚出短视口
issues.body:
## 缺陷

`MarkdownEditor` 工具栏的 `command-more` 溢出按钮（显示为 `插入 (n)` / overflow label）使用 `position: sticky; inset-inline-end: 0` 做横向钉住。当工具栏本身不是纵向 sticky（非 `profile-prose`）时，页面纵向滚动后该按钮的 `getBoundingClientRect().top < -2`——元素计算样式仍为 `position: sticky`，表现为「sticky 控件逃出视口」。

## 复现证据（消费者 FsusBlog 真实渲染验收）

- 环境：FsusBlog UX viewport 验收（Chromium，`mobile-landscape` 844×390），真实后端 + 生产构建
- 路由：`manage-write`（light/dark 双主题均复现）
- 断言输出：`fixed/sticky control is outside viewport: 插入 (15)`
- 触发方式：短视口下页面纵向滚动使工具栏滚出视口上缘

## 期望

`command-more` 的可达性不应依赖纵向位置：

- 方案 A：将溢出按钮移出横向滚动条容器，作为不滚动的 flex 兄弟节点（无需 sticky）
- 方案 B：在紧凑/移动布局下让工具栏纵向 sticky，使命令持续可达（与 `profile-prose` 已有语义一致）

由组件所有者裁定哪一种是契约意图；两种修法都不改变信息架构与动作数量。

## 范围边界

- 这是 FsusUI 组件几何/定位缺陷，消费者不做私有选择器覆盖
- 消费者侧 issue：Ozwasyd/FsusBlog#3475（验收证据与修复跟踪）
- FsusUI 基线：`f2b3bb89ffe5f749da26c388f058efdbb6aee864`（`vue/packages/theme-chalk/src/markdown-editor.scss` `command-more` 段）
issues.display_title: fix(vue/markdown-editor): command-more 溢出按钮以 sticky 定位随工具栏纵向滚出短视口

issues.title: ops(renovate): 安装官方 Mend App 并取得初始真实升级 PR 证据
issues.body:
Parent: #316
Depends on: #413, #414, #415

## 执行分类
- 类型：`external-renovate-app-activation`
- 优先级：P1
- `dispatchable: false`，需要仓库/组织管理员在 GitHub UI 完成 App 安装与授权。

## 唯一目标
安装官方 Mend Renovate GitHub App、授权当前仓库、触发真实扫描，并为每个固定 group 取得升级 PR 或零更新证据。此 issue 不修改 Renovate 配置、不修复升级失败、不启用 automerge。

## 人工步骤
- 安装官方 Mend Renovate App 到 `Ozwasyd/FsusUI`，仅授予其正常运行所需权限。
- 确认不存在 PAT、自托管 bot、Dependabot 或第二 updater。
- 触发 initial scan/Dependency Dashboard。
- 保存 App installation identity、scan/run URL、时间、config commit SHA 与 sanitized parser logs。

## 必须验证
- App 实际读取当前 `renovate.json5` 与 update-surface config。
- npm authority、NuGet、Actions、images/toolchains/custom fields 出现在真实解析日志。
- 每个固定 group 有真实 PR，或 Dashboard/dry-run 证明当前无 update。
- npm PR 同时修改 authority、必要 projection 与 lockfile，并通过 `deps:check`。
- automerge 保持 false，未创建 duplicate/projection-only PR。

## 固定约束
- Agent 不得声称自行安装 App 或创建管理员授权。
- 缺少管理员操作时 external-blocked，父 #316 不可关闭。
- 不手工在配置 PR 中夹带全仓升级冒充 initial evidence。
- 不提供 PAT 或写入 secret 到仓库。

## 验收条件
- [ ] 官方 App installation 和真实 scan 可验证。
- [ ] 全部 manager/custom manager 出现在解析日志。
- [ ] 每个 group 有真实 PR 或零更新 evidence。
- [ ] PR 边界/authority/lockfile 符合 #414，required checks 可运行。
- [ ] 无第二 updater、automerge 或永久 ignore。
- [ ] 只有本 issue 完成后父 #316 才可关闭。

## 非目标
- 不合并升级 PR、不修复 dependency breaking changes。
